note: SYSTEM (compact) vs RAW fact sets for the gdctx fact-preservation oracle. Both sides captured from a REAL `keryx ctx run -- ` compaction of this repo's own tree (dogfood) and reduced to facts via the shared, documented extractFacts rule (src/metrics/oracle-runner.ts). rawFacts/compactFacts are what factPreservation scores; rawLines/compactLines are for human sanity-checking, not scored. `inputs` (above) are captured dogfood compressions that are LOSSY BY DESIGN (a compression benchmark) and must stay untouched by the regenerator. `goldens` (below) are a SEPARATE, self-contained correctness benchmark (W7-AC6): each entry supplies its own input and is recomputed LIVE by src/metrics/gdctx-goldens.test.ts against the real src/commands/ctx.ts (summarizeCommandOutput) / src/security/guard.ts (redactRaw) functions — nothing here is captured output. `kind: "ctx-run"` goldens (GDCTX-1: a clean, exit-0 stdout line must not be misread as a failure verdict merely because it contains failure-shaped English prose) score fact agreement the documented way: rawFacts = extractFacts(mergedRaw), compactFacts = extractFacts(the rendered summary), and the test requires every rawFact to survive (agreement 1.0), plus `expectErrorsSection` and `mustContainInSummary` are checked literally. `kind: "ctx-read-redaction"` goldens (GDCTX-2: a trusted-project badge/logo URL survives redaction, but a credential-shaped query on the same URL shape still redacts) do NOT run their `content` through extractFacts — a bare badge URL embedded in ``/`![alt](url)` markup contains no bare file-path or key:value token by extractFacts' narrow rule, so that would score a vacuous, always-passing 0/0 agreement. Instead, per golden, `mustContain` IS the fact set: the test's rawFacts are exactly `mustContain` (the literal, credential-free strings the content minus its `mustNotContain` entries is expected to survive as), and compactFacts is the subset of those found verbatim (substring match) in `redactRaw`'s output; agreement is required to be 1.0 (every mustContain string survives) and every `mustNotContain` string is additionally asserted absent from the output.
